{{Quote|Bilbringi Depot is secured.''"<br />"''You have done well, bounty hunter. I trust you left no evidence of your work.''"<br />"''I never leave a mess unless I'm paid to leave a mess. I'm a professional.|Cad Bane and Darth Sidious|<ref name="TCWSM3" />}}
'''Bilbringi Depot''' was the primary settlement of [[Bilbringi VII]], the largest [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] of the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was owned by [[Drixo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] lost custody of the depot to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], who secured it for [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. It was later liberated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Breakout Squad]], who captured Overseer [[Umbrag]].
